meta.notes: D1 is used for T2 and T6 as it can fly over obstacles and has a short deadline. M1 handles T3 and T8 due to its payload capacity. G1 tackles T1 and T7 as it can carry heavy payloads. M2 is used for T4 and T9 for its moderate payload and speed. G2 handles T5 and T10 for its endurance and payload capacity. M1 and G1 are kept free for standby.
